setup: Install the skill with the button below
Nothing to configure: no key, wallet or account. It reads Base mainnet through the public RPC https://mainnet.base.org; set MAAT_GUARD_RPC_URL to use your own
Ask: "is the US stock market open right now?" or "would Maat's vault accept a $5 NVDAc buy now?"
Trade only on "allowed": true. A refusal names its typed reason, such as MARKET_CLOSED, FEED_STALE or PREMIUM_TOO_HIGH, and a failed read exits 2: treat it as a no
